mechanism: Indexing-time agent exploration of the repository that caches speculative cross-file context for later code completion
evidence_scope: SpecAgent, a speculative context construction framework that shifts repository-specific retrieval from inference time to indexing time
evidence_role: We address this limitation with SpecAgent, an agent that improves both latency and code-generation quality by proactively exploring repository files dur- ing indexing and constructing speculative con- text that anticipates future edits in each file.
